easy_vic_build.tools.geo_func

Geospatial utility modules.

Modules in this subpackage provide clipping, GeoDataFrame creation, format conversion, grid searching, and resampling helpers.

Modules

clip

Clipping utilities for array grids and GeoTIFF rasters.

create_gdf

GeoDataFrame construction helpers for common geometry types.

fill_gap

Module easy_vic_build.tools.geo_func.fill_gap.

format_conversion

Format-conversion helpers for geospatial datasets.

reproject

Module easy_vic_build.tools.geo_func.reproject.

resample

Resampling methods for grid-based geospatial variables.

search_grids

Grid-search utilities for matching source and destination coordinates.
